title: Model onboarding: hardware calibration workflow and release matrix for A100/H100/L40S/MI300
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: define and publish hardware-specific performance profiles and a deterministic onboarding workflow for new model versions across our supported GPU families (NVIDIA A100, H100, L40S and AMD MI300). This ticket captures the calibration steps, performance signature artifacts, schema for the release matrix that maps model+version to profile IDs, and the CI gating rules for automated publishing. We need a reproducible pipeline so model owners can reliably onboard a variant and pin a model->profile mapping for Hosted/Dedicated/Private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical onboarding checklist exists and is documented in Confluence with step-by-step commands
A release matrix CSV produced from the pipeline that lists model_name, model_version, profile_id, hw_family, median_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_second, quant_config
CI job (onboarding-calibrate) runs in <24h for a single model variant and uploads profiles to the profile registry
Rollout gating rules implemented in the console: canary -> ramp -> full with automatic fallback to compatible profile family
Smoke canary that runs on representative queries for each hardware family and fails if regression >5% in p95 latency or 2% in output-quality (eval set)
Backward-compatible pinning: a profile ID can be pinned to a model minor version and the pin recorded in audit logs
tasks: Define profile schema and stable signature format (CSV + JSON metadata) - owner: Jonah
Add quantization parameters and kernel hints to profile metadata - owner: ML infra
Implement calibration harness for A100/H100/L40S/MI300 using perf-bench runner - owner: eng-performance
Create CI pipeline that runs calibration, validates signatures, and uploads to profile registry - owner: infra-ci
Console UI: expose profile selection and pinning with audit trail - owner: product-engineering
Design and run smoke evals for output-quality regression per-model - owner: applied-ml
Document onboarding playbook and update onboarding templates in the model-onboarding repo - owner: docs

decision_notes: Profiles are immutable once signed and published. If calibration is re-run, a new profile_id is created rather than mutating existing entries.
Profile metadata will include a short 'kernel_hint' to inform runtime kernel selection but the runtime retains final authority to choose kernels based on device runtime heuristics.
Pinning semantics: pin(model_name, minor_version) -> profile_id. Major version upgrades require explicit reprofiling and pin updates.
Rollout policy: every new profile publication triggers an automated canary on Hosted region with 1% traffic for 6 hours, ramp logic in console with automatic rollback on SLO violations.
